title: Mission Event v1
description: GET /v1/missions/:id/events 与租户级 GET /v1/events 的 SSE data。id 为 event_id 的 URI 编码，event 为 mission-event。连接先回放已提交历史，再推送新增事件；局部流的 Last-Event-ID 必须属于本 Mission，全局流的 Last-Event-ID 必须属于本租户任一 Mission。重连仍回放完整历史，以免 PostgreSQL 并发事务晚提交的低 lamport 事件被跳过；客户端按 event_id 去重，不能把 lamport 当提交游标。至少一次投递，不修改 Outbox delivered 标记。DAG_NODE_FINISHED 和 DAG_NODE_BLOCKED 只触发客户端按需重读节点状态。不公开 payload、提示词或 Agent 原始输出。无权限与不存在均为 404，未知游标为 400。 TASK_DISPATCH_INTENT records atomic durable binding and RUNNING transition before external send or CLI process start; it is not proof of remote acceptance or process termination. INPUT_REQUIRED can record lost CLI runtime observation without asserting a terminal result. REVIEW_APPLICATION_INTENT is not completion; REVIEW_APPLICATION_COMPLETED requires all intended effects verified. Public appendEvent preserves supplied metadata and rejects changed semantic fields for an existing idempotency key; timestamp differences alone remain idempotent. Event IDs are opaque globally unique identities; lamport owns ordering.
